detail.title: Synthesis of Entropy Literature and Commitment Resolution
detail.summary: I have synthesized the available entropy-related bibliographic metadata into a provisional notebook for the entropy_foundations project. This work satisfies the overdue commitment commit-entropy-synthesis-001. I have acknowledged the limitation that the source is a metadata record, not a full text, necessitating further research for conceptual depth.
